pages.text: Most crops follow the day-based lifecycle. A few behave specially:$(li)$(item)Melon & pumpkin stems$() do not wither when over-mature. Instead, at each 6:00 settlement they try to place a fruit on an adjacent empty dirt/grass block.$(li)$(item)Cocoa beans$() grow on jungle logs and do not need water at all.

pages.title: Managed crop types
pages.text: The lifecycle covers:$(li)crops (wheat, carrots...)$(li)stems (melon, pumpkin)$(li)nether wart$(li)cocoa$(li)sweet berry bushes$(br2)Bamboo, vines and other growing plants keep their vanilla behavior.
